items.title: ALDI makes new move to win shoppers from Walmart and Kroger
items.summary: ALDI has entered the battle among grocery chains competing for shoppers seeking cheaper, faster dinners.

items.title: Costco and Kroger pizza partner closes beloved restaurants
items.summary: The popular pizza dining chain is closing dining locations as it expands its wholesale production.

items.title: Walmart and Kroger Compete for the Same Shopper. Their Dividends Are a Different Story
items.summary: Kroger's yield triples Walmart's, but a fatter dividend check at the start can mask a fragile payout years down the road. One of these grocery giants is built to keep raising through recessions, margin squeezes, and shifting consumer habits, and it may not be the one you expect.

items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook Highlights Walmart, Kroger and Yesway
items.summary: Walmart, Kroger and Yesway are positioned to benefit from omnichannel growth, loyalty programs, private brands and new retail profit pools.

items.title: Kroger’s AI focus is on ‘flexibility and control,’ digital chief says
items.summary: From bridging the digital and physical shopping worlds to further ramping up effective personalization, the grocer’s chief digital officer delved into the company’s priorities.

items.title: 3 Supermarket Stocks Set to Benefit From Omnichannel & Loyalty Growth
items.summary: Omnichannel growth, private brands, retail media and automation reshape supermarkets, while productivity efforts help manage cost pressures, creating opportunities for WMT, KR and YSWY.

items.title: Kroger sees AI shopping assistant driving larger baskets
items.summary: Grocer’s chief digital officer says strong data, flexible technology and customer trust are central to the company’s AI strategy

items.title: Kroger EVP Mary Ellen Adcock Sells 72,901 Shares for $4.4 Million
items.summary: Adcock exercised nearly 49,000 stock options at $38.32 before liquidating a larger block, capturing the spread between grant and market prices. She retains ~175,000 shares worth $10.51 million.
